main.description: Create a postPrivate reply under another account's audience. The record must carry reply.parent and an audienceList naming the audience record of the post being replied to; the writer is checked against that audience before the write. Every audience refusal returns the same Forbidden response.

repo.description: DID of the writer's repository. Must be the authenticated account.

rkey.description: Record key. A TID is generated when absent.

validate.description: Lexicon validation preference, as for com.atproto.repo.createRecord.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The record is malformed, or lacks reply.parent or audienceList.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may not write to this repository, the host does not allow this account private-tier writes, or the audience check denied the reply.

errors.name: UnsupportedNamespace
errors.description: The host does not have the private tier enabled.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: An embed references a blob the host does not hold.
